notes.real_osm: bridges marked src=osm_road_x_canal sit where a layout road (OSM highway) crosses a layout canal (OSM waterway); power-line routes follow OSM residential/secondary roads; cargo/longtail/hyacinth routes follow OSM canal centrelines; motorbike routes follow the OSM road graph.
notes.religious_and_cemeteries: osm_buildings/osm_landuse contain NO church, temple, religious or cemetery feature inside this 2x2 km window, so religious[] is empty and graves[] holds only procedural family tombs (house gardens). Nearest real ones (scene coords, outside the window) are listed in nearest_real_religious for horizon/backdrop use.

nearest_real_religious.name: Nhà Thờ Giáo Họ Tân Thành

notes.procedural: pole spacing/side, transformer poles, lift nets, fish stakes, pumps, shrines, washing steps, moored boats, family tombs, duck flocks, people, dogs, smoke, straw, vegetation, fish-jump zones and between-house monkey bridges are placed by rule (seeded), not observed. Flooded/dry parcel states come from layout.parcels (synthetic per layout attribution).
notes.bridge_kind_rule: concrete for vehicle roads (residential/service/secondary) or canals >= 20 m; monkey for path/footway on < 20 m canals and for placed between-house crossings.
notes.rot: radians about +Y; local +Z = model front = (sin rot, cos rot); local +X = (cos rot, -sin rot)
notes.route_mode: pingpong = traverse back and forth along points
